description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero, adding {1}.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Antler Skulkin by paying {2}, giving Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader persist until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader, adding {1}.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.name: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader
